_comment: Per-IP limiting for /api/tutor, in the exact shape of one entry of `rules` in the Vercel Firewall API (PUT/PATCH /v1/security/firewall/config). Vercel does not read this file — rate-limit rules can't live in vercel.json — so apply it via the API or re-create it by hand under Project -> Firewall. Pro caps rate-limit windows at 10 minutes, hence 600 s. No persistent block (actionDuration null): a timed ban would black out a whole hospital behind one NAT.
name: tutor-per-ip
description: AI tutor demo: 10 POSTs per 10 min per IP (hospital NAT-safe). See docs/firewall-rules.json in the repo.
